comment: claude-code 2.1.270 is one Bun-compiled ELF per platform, byte-identical in the npm platform package and the release bucket; it re-executes itself as rg, so one read/execute rule on that file covers it. No node runtime or package directory is granted, and layouts that start claude through node are refused. Checksums are the release manifest's (downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/2.1.270/manifest.json).
name: claude-code
activation: the authenticated conformance runs (plan step 3; the TestRealClaude* tests) passed for 2.1.270 linux-arm64 in an ABI 9 guest (Fedora CoreOS 44, Linux 7.1.4): a model-driven Edit and Write turn with its file history, a Bash write outside every grant refused by the OS, a Task subagent, one stdio MCP server whose read outside every grant was refused, --resume in a caller StateDir and Reopen in private state, a contain-login login in a caller StateDir through a token refresh, and G5's session, transcript, history and usage routing across private, caller and uncontained sessions in one working directory. Remote managed settings were not exercised: 2.1.270 loads them only for team and enterprise subscriptions, and the runs signed in with a max one

paths.reason: managed-settings layer: claude refuses to start when managed settings exist but are unreadable

env_reasons.DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER: without it each session copies the 224 MB binary into its private HOME
env_reasons.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC: leaves api.anthropic.com as the only endpoint contacted
env_reasons.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE: no plugin-marketplace download into private state

max_tmpdir_reason: claude binds $TMPDIR/cc-socks/<pid>.sock; a path over 103 bytes falls back to /tmp/cc-socks-<uid>, which every same-user session shares and the domain denies

login.tcp_bind: a 127.0.0.1 OAuth callback server, which claude starts even when the person pastes the code; without it the login fails with "Failed to start OAuth callback server"
login.reason: claude auth login prints a sign-in URL whose page shows a code once the person has signed in, and waits at "Paste code here if prompted" for it, so no browser is needed on this host. The login is stored in CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.credentials.json; claude auth status --json reports loggedIn for exactly that directory.
